import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { hostSource, sha } from './semantic-long.mjs';
const view = source => source.map(m => ({text:m.mes,user:m.is_user,name:m.name}));
export async function runSummarize({page,field,generate,assert:check,setStage,result,frozen,checkpoint,generations}) {
    const {plan}=frozen;
    Object.assign(result,{version:plan.version,planSha256:frozen.sha256,fixtureSha256:plan.fixtureSha256,settings:plan.settings,generation:plan.generation,summarySettings:plan.summarySettings,preparation:[],rows:[],complete:false});
    if(await field('enabled').isChecked())await field('enabled').setChecked(false);
    await page.evaluate(settings=>{
        const c=SillyTavern.getContext();Object.assign(c.extensionSettings.memory,settings);
        c.extensionSettings.vectors.enabled_chats=false;
    },plan.summarySettings);
    for(const item of plan.cases) {
        const source=hostSource(item), sourceHash=sha(JSON.stringify(view(source))), chatId=`summary-prepare-${item.id}`;
        setStage(`summary/${item.id}/prepare`);
        await page.evaluate(async({source,chatId})=>{const c=SillyTavern.getContext();await c.openCharacterChat(chatId);c.chat.splice(0,c.chat.length,...source);await c.saveChat();await c.reloadCurrentChat();},{source,chatId});
        const preparation={case:item.id,chatId,sourceHash,steps:[],summary:null};result.preparation.push(preparation);
        let lastIndex=-1;
        for(let step=0;lastIndex<source.length-2;step++) {
            check(step<plan.maxSummariesPerCase,`${item.id}: summary call bound`);
            setStage(`summary/${item.id}/update-${step+1}`);const start=generations.length, started=performance.now();
            const observed=await page.evaluate(async()=>{
                const c=SillyTavern.getContext();const outcome=await c.executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/summarize quiet=true');
                const latest=c.chat.findLastIndex(m=>Boolean(m.extra?.memory));
                await c.saveChat();
                return {value:outcome.pipe,index:latest,stored:c.chat[latest]?.extra?.memory,prompt:c.extensionPrompts['1_memory']?.value,source:c.chat.map(m=>({text:m.mes,user:m.is_user,name:m.name}))};
            });
            check(generations.length===start+1,`${item.id}: one actual-host summary request`);
            const request=generations.at(-1);request.kind='summary';request.summaryCase=item.id;request.summaryStep=step+1;
            request.generationMs=performance.now()-started-(request.attempts?.[0]?.spacingWaitMs||0);
            check(request.upstreamStatus===200 && observed.value?.trim()===request.providerAnswer?.trim() && observed.stored===observed.value,`${item.id}: provider summary stored exactly`);
            check(observed.index>lastIndex && observed.index<=source.length-2,`${item.id}: summary advances source cursor`);
            check(sha(JSON.stringify(observed.source))===sourceHash,`${item.id}: summary preserves source chat`);
            preparation.steps.push({requestIndex:start,from:lastIndex+1,to:observed.index,summary:observed.value,finishReason:request.finishReason});
            lastIndex=observed.index;preparation.summary=observed.value;await checkpoint();
        }
        const saved=await page.evaluate(()=>SillyTavern.getContext().chat);
        for(const sample of plan.schedule.filter(s=>s.case===item.id)) {
            const answerChat=`summary-answer-${sample.id.replaceAll('/','-')}`;
            await page.evaluate(async({saved,answerChat,enabled})=>{const c=SillyTavern.getContext();await c.openCharacterChat(answerChat);const copy=structuredClone(saved);if(!enabled)for(const m of copy)delete m.extra.memory;c.chat.splice(0,c.chat.length,...copy);await c.saveChat();await c.reloadCurrentChat();},{saved,answerChat,enabled:sample.mode==='summary'});
            const before=await page.evaluate(async()=>{const c=SillyTavern.getContext(),text=c.extensionPrompts['1_memory']?.value||'';return {text,tokens:await c.getTokenCountAsync(text)};});
            check(sample.mode==='summary'?before.text===`[Summary: ${preparation.summary}]`:!before.text,`${sample.id}: native summary prompt state`);
            const output=await generate(`summary/${sample.id}`,'normal',false,{question:item.question,evaluate:true});
            const request=output.request;request.kind='answer';request.semanticSampleId=sample.id;
            const prompt=request.messages.map(m=>m.content).join('\n');
            check(prompt.includes(item.question)&&prompt.includes(plan.generation.instruction),`${sample.id}: question and instruction delivered`);
            if(sample.mode==='summary')check(prompt.includes(before.text),`${sample.id}: exact native summary delivered`);
            const recentPreserved=source.slice(-7).every(m=>prompt.includes(m.mes));
            const after=await page.evaluate(n=>SillyTavern.getContext().chat.slice(0,n).map(m=>({text:m.mes,user:m.is_user,name:m.name})),source.length);
            check(sha(JSON.stringify(after))===sourceHash && output.chatLength===source.length+2,`${sample.id}: source preserved after answer`);
            assert(!prompt.includes('Past conversation excerpt'));
            result.rows.push({...sample,chatId:answerChat,sourceHash,requestIndex:generations.length-1,answer:output.last,summary:before.text,summaryTokens:before.tokens,recentPreserved,usage:request.providerUsage});
            await checkpoint();console.log(`RESULT ${sample.id}: delivery verified; answer quality ungraded`);
        }
    }
    result.complete=result.rows.length===plan.schedule.length;
}
